spans.s: klamatha, kilamatha, m. (= Skt. Lex. kla˚, Pali kilamatha; 〔§ 22.44〕), weariness, fatigue: Mvy 〔7336〕 klamathaḥ; SP 〔21.4〕; 〔258.8〕 (vs); LV 〔392.18〕; 〔416.20〕; Śikṣ 〔252.10〕; Bbh 〔81.1〕; 〔185.6〕; 〔187.11〕; kilamatha, Mv 〔ii.483.11〕 (vs), by plausible em., naitaṃ (so with v.l., text na etaṃ, unmetr.) kilamathaṃ mahyaṃ (the forms are n. sg., as if nt.; otherwise the word is always m.); 〔iii.331.6〕 (prose) ātmakilamathānuyogo; Gv 〔488.16〕 (vs) kilamatho (meter correct).
